ir.name: usw_source_length_relative_gap_temperature_jssp50x20
ir.intuition: Preserve H7's source-length and mean logit scale while emphasizing wider-quality pairs through a mean-one relative-gap temperature inside the sigmoid link.
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw_mean = batch['log_prob_w_mean']
    lpl_mean = batch['log_prob_l_mean']
    weight = batch['weight']
    advantage_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    epsilon = 1e-6
    source_steps = 100.0
    abs_adv = ops.abs(advantage_gap)
    mean_gap = ops.maximum(ops.mean(abs_adv), epsilon)
    source_diff = ops.mul(ops.sub(lpw_mean, lpl_mean), source_steps)
    base = ops.div(source_diff, mean_gap)
    temperature = ops.div(abs_adv, mean_gap)
    diff = ops.mul(base, temperature)
    loss = ops.neg(ops.log(ops.sigmoid(diff)))
    weighted_loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)
    return ops.div(ops.sum(weighted_loss), ops.maximum(ops.sum(weight), epsilon))
